question: What disciplined practice in solitude enables the creation of many forms?
premises: The practice is to be performed in solitude.
The practitioner is instructed to create many forms.
The practitioner must be intent on meditation.
inference: In solitude, one intent on meditation should practice creating many forms.
uncertainties: The imperative kuru may be read as direct instruction within the meditative method.
plain_english: In solitude, intent on meditation, create many forms.
